stories.title: Remove dead code and unused packages
stories.why: Less code to read and ship: delete what nothing uses and move test-only shortcuts out of the app.

stories.title: Make the site's forms send data safely
stories.why: Forms post through the shared network layer with no cookies or referrer leaking.

stories.title: Make a fresh checkout pass every check
stories.why: A new contributor can clone, install and run every gate with no manual fixes.

stories.title: Fix the broken publish job and slim the repo
stories.why: CI stops reporting a failing job, and clones get faster.

stories.title: Prove recent fixes on real devices and in production
stories.why: Checks that code alone can't prove.

stories.title: Fix failing and flaky tests
stories.why: A red test means a real bug again.

stories.title: Make the answer reveal work with screen readers
stories.why: Children using keyboards or screen readers hear the answer when it is revealed.

stories.title: Agree the ground rules and add architecture guardrails
stories.why: The rules and lint checks that every later phase relies on.

stories.title: Send all storage, network and sound through shared ports
stories.why: One place owns each kind of browser I/O, so screens stop repeating error handling.

stories.title: Put every screen inside the shared page layout
stories.why: Every screen uses the same header, footer and column instead of its own.

stories.title: Turn every subject's questions into checked content
stories.why: Questions are validated records, so a typo fails the build instead of a child's game.

stories.title: Break the giant game screen into small modules
stories.why: The 8,894-line game file becomes a thin router plus one module per screen.

stories.title: Stop low-level code importing from higher layers
stories.why: Imports point one way only, so changing a screen can't break the core.

stories.title: Lock in backend contracts and make the checks blocking
stories.why: Secrets, migrations and headers have one source each; then the baselines become hard gates.

stories.title: Retire the old GitHub Pages site
stories.why: The live site is the workers.dev one only.

stories.title: Make the 3D world and clue scenes feel cinematic
stories.why: Richer motion for the globe and clue scenes.

stories.title: Fix problems seen on the live site
stories.why: Bugs and requests from real use.

stories.title: Grow subjects, age bands and shared play
stories.why: New content and modes for more children.
